facts: Parties: Kestrel Medical Ltd (Buyer), Orwell Marine Ltd (Seller); the Company is Merrion Marine Ltd.
This Agreement is dated 8 June 2026; Closing is scheduled for 11 September 2026 (the 'Closing Date').
Section 3.4 (Earn-out): the Earn-out Payment equals 3 times the amount by which FY2026 EBITDA exceeds $4,000,000, capped at $10,000,000.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.
Management accounts show FY2026 EBITDA of $4,800,000; the Seller says the Earn-out Payment will therefore be $3,300,000.

Clause 14.2: either party may terminate this agreement on 30 days' notice if the other party undergoes a change of control without its prior written consent. The counterparty is Ashcombe Logistics plc.
Disclosure against Warranty 6.3 (Material Contracts): no material contract contains a change of control provision. (No further disclosure.)
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 45 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
